dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Perfect, looks like my gift is all set.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Is it time for your return journey, then? If you're heading back to Dornman Port, I'd be happy to accompany you.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Yeah, I think I've gotten my fill of sight-seeing, so it's probably time I headed back. Don't wanna keep my crew waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I'll see you some other time. Oh, and good luck with your business!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Reconnaissance Company, I'd like to express my gratitude to you as well.
